      The Gaffer's rating for you
      51 pts this week

      6 weeks alone on top ended in one week. Bench Disaster sealed it.

      Cherag's long reign at the top is over. Ayodele takes the crown, 8 clear. The crown has now changed hands 4 times this season, so nobody should get comfy. Sid is third, 29 off the pace.

      Winners
      9Dominic

      Started Trafford alone and he returned 10. A brave punt, and the climb up from 24th is turning into a proper recovery.

      8Maanav

      4 weeks of creeping off the bottom, and now up to 19th. Not a fluke. Skill, quietly applied.

      Losers
      2Cherag

      24 points on the bench in the week the lead went. That is the Bench Disaster award, and it was earned.

      3IB

      Bottom again after a tough spell. Elvin is only 7 points ahead, so one decent week could change the picture.

      3Ravi

      The worst week of the season, and down to 13th. Bad luck stopped being the excuse a while ago.

      Decision of the week
      Hishaan captained Barry instead of Haaland. 32 with the armband against 4 for the Haaland crowd, a 28-point swing. Nobody else dared. Nerve first, then a worldie.
      One to watch in GW11
      Ayodele against Cherag again. If Gakpo starts repaying the transfer, Ayodele could stretch clear. If Cherag sorts the bench, the lead could flip straight back.

      How it's worked out

      Each manager gets a 0-100 score from three things, across every gameweek this season (10 so far): how many of the league picked the same captain (45%), how many of their 11 are in most other teams (45%), and points spent on hits (10%). The fewer people you copy, the more daring you are. 50 is your league's average manager. Ghosts (no transfers or chips in 3+ gameweeks) aren't rated.
